scientific_question: Can a fixed-FHT-conjugated block-Cayley output chart recover the task-useful c_proj output-frame motion without discrete pair selection or learned bases?

identity.execution_commit_rule: record a clean pushed commit containing this immutable plan before implementation

shared_hidden_chart.feedback: zero for this one-step prospective diagnostic
shared_hidden_chart.weight_decay_application: identical production ordering in both arms

control.name: frobenius_output32
control.definition: Existing top-neighbor Frobenius pair selector with simultaneous Frobenius residual-fit angles.

candidate.name: fht_block32_cayley1
candidate.basis: one exact fixed signed/permuted normalized block-FHT basis and its inverse

fit.per_block_equation: C B + B C = D - D^T, where C=X^T X and D=X^T R
fit.solver: symmetric eigendecomposition of C in float64; denominator lambda_i+lambda_j+1e-6*mean(diag(C))
fit.trust_radius: multiply all A blocks in a layer-phase cell by min(1, max_abs(control_output32_angle)/max_abs(A))
fit.application: apply the exact block Cayley transform in the fixed basis, invert the basis, transpose, and use the same decoupled-weight-decay ordering as control

prohibited: fit or selection on holdout tokens
post-hoc trust radius or seed tuning

pass_all: all outputs, eigensolves, Cayley solves, and metrics are finite
candidate uses exactly 147072 coordinates per selected layer and no more coordinates than the 147456-coordinate control
every candidate coordinate obeys the cell's frozen Frobenius-output32 maximum-angle trust radius
aggregate held-out activation-output residual energy is no more than 0.95 times control
aggregate update energy is no more than 1.10 times control
aggregate held-out predicted CE descent is positive, strictly greater than control, and at least 0.004353292856055148
candidate beats control on all four held-out finite-step CE comparisons and at least seven of all eight comparisons
mean candidate finite-step CE is at least 0.0005 lower than control and no greater than 7.180657014250755
decision_rule.pass_action: preregister a production fixed-basis block-Cayley output matcher, add exact-resume/correctness tests, and require an I/O-inclusive at-least-20-percent MFU gate before considering one 124M causal run
decision_rule.fail_action: reject this fixed-basis block-Cayley output family without causal training; the next structural branch must be non-orthogonal or couple c_proj transport to block-output state rather than revisiting output pair selection
